title: EvidentialState
description: The computed state of a relation with respect to REGISTERED evidence under one profile and time. These are EVIDENCE STATES, not declarations of domain truth: `supported` (admissible supporting evidence, no admissible refuting evidence), `refuted` (admissible refuting evidence, no admissible supporting evidence), `contested` (both admissible supporting and refuting evidence), `unsupported` (no admissible evidence either way).
